kind: source-only unit checks; no Lens runtime claim
checks: hero step 3 has six fixed pieces and one incoming axle
explode never moves fixed receivers and is reversible (every step)
inspect exit restores rotated and zoomed view
inspect and underside roundtrip restores original pitch
home clears inspect and underside restoration state
button-rail press cannot become an orbit drag
view bounds remain bounded (zoom 0.65..1.3, pitch ±170)
zoom steps land exactly on 1.15 and 1.3
invalid canonical rotation and invalid receiver rejected
all seven steps construct; visible pieces grow 5,6,7,8,12,13,18
initial state: step 1, gear anchor fixed, four pins incoming, nothing confirmed, view from below
inspect keeps the authored side but limits elevation to ±30° on every step
Inspect cycles through every incoming joint, then Return restores the view (all steps)
Home and step changes leave Inspect at joint 1
step-1 other-side view looks from above, and back
every incoming piece of every step is incoming exactly once
manual confirmation advances 1→7 and finishes assembled
step change resets inspect, explode and view to the new step's home
back keeps confirmations; back from finished reopens step 7; back at step 1 stays
re-confirming a reviewed step does not duplicate it
restart clears confirmations and returns to the initial state
step numbers must be contiguous from 1
a piece may appear in only one step
an anchor (non-incoming piece in a step) must not move
a first step with no anchor has nothing to receive and is rejected
a receiver from a later step is rejected
a step with no incoming piece is rejected
a separation path shorter than the insertion depth is rejected
a missing step is rejected when requested
